performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat6 24AWG (6.1 mm) cables at 100 % fill, theoretical; 25 at the recommended 30 % - FS Horizontal Cable Managers with D-rings datasheet, Cable Capacity Reference Guide

physical.mounting-hardware: M6*15mm Screw x4 and M6Nut x4

configs.description: The cable manager as FS ships #177305, five rings fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, panel and ring material, rack units and the mounting hardware are the D-rings datasheet's specification table.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - 83 Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm cables at 100 % fill, and 25 at the recommended 30 %, in the Cable Capacity Reference Guide of FS's D-rings datasheet. Stated once, here, and not divided among the rings.

chassis.note: drawing - 430 x 44 x 100. The plate is flat over the whole 19 in [482.6mm] and its top and bottom edges fold back over 16.9 in [430mm], 1.04 in [26.3mm] in from each end; the flat ends outside the folds are the ears, which this library does not draw, so the body is the 430. The datasheet's 3.46 in (88 mm) depth is the ring's lower arm from the face of the plate; the side view adds the folded edges, 12 mm behind it (3.5 in [89mm] from their back edge to the end of the upper arm, less the arm's 3 in [77mm]), so the envelope is 100 deep.

color.note: estimated - "Steel, Powder-coated Black" and "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render.

front.note: drawing - the front view: the plate between the folds and the five rings. Rings centred 35 mm from the left fold and 90 apart: the drawing dimensions 1.04 in [26.3mm] plus 1.4 in [35mm] to the first ring's centre and 3.5 in [90mm] between centres, and the five read 90.0 mm apart at 2.161 px/mm, symmetric about the middle. Each ring is 12.7 wide; its contract has the rest. FS's mark, printed on the plate just inside the left fold, is not drawn: a vendor mark never is.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings stand 88 mm in front of the panel and the panel's folded edges reach only 12 behind it (the vendor's side view), so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part (#854).

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the datasheet's side view: the folded edges behind the plate and the ring's profile in front of it, its hook and its curled lip. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FIRST, FROM THE VENDOR'S OWN DIMENSIONED DRAWING. FS's Horizontal Cable Managers with D-rings datasheet draws the CMH-5DR1U-N in a side view and a front view, dimensioned in inches with millimetres in brackets. Its front view is 2.161 px/mm across from the 482.6 line (1043 px) and 2.227 px/mm down from the 44 (98 px), a 3 % difference between the axes; the 430, 90 and 35 lines agree with the across scale to under a millimetre. Positions are read across and heights down.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate, plain. FS publishes one render of the back (gallery image 2), which shows the plate and its folded edges and nothing else.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.2 mm, the sheet FS dimensions on the CMH-4DRB1U drawing of the same datasheet. No view of this part dimensions its sheet.

top.note: drawing - an elevation: the folded edge behind the plate, and the five rings' upper arms from above to 77 mm, with the lower arms reaching on to 88. The bottom is the same from underneath, where the lower arms are seen whole.

weight.note: datasheet - 0.64 kg in the specification table of FS's product page for #177305. The D-rings datasheet states no weight for any of its four managers. The page is not a held document.
